name: large sieve inequality
statement: Quadratic inequality controlling simultaneous character or additive-phase correlations across many moduli.
claim_ceiling: Does not by itself prove Bombieri-Vinogradov or prime production.

name: dual large sieve
statement: Dual formulation exchanging coefficient and frequency families under a quadratic norm bound.
claim_ceiling: Finite duality is not an asymptotic distribution theorem.

name: Bombieri-Vinogradov theorem
statement: Average prime-distribution theorem over moduli up to approximately square-root scale with logarithmic loss.
claim_ceiling: Known theorem; not a new project result and not Elliott-Halberstam.

name: average residue discrepancy norm
statement: Sum over moduli of maximal reduced-residue discrepancies for Chebyshev-type observables.
claim_ceiling: Finite computation does not certify an asymptotic average theorem.

name: residue-channel energy pushforward
statement: Decode valuation vectors, route integers into residue channels, and aggregate squared phase correlations.
claim_ceiling: Preserves finite sums but does not create cancellation.

name: pointwise versus average distribution
statement: Pointwise control for each modulus is strictly stronger than a summed or averaged modulus certificate unless an additional transfer argument is supplied.
claim_ceiling: Average control must not be reported as uniform pointwise control.

name: large sieve to average distribution dependency
statement: Large-sieve energy control can feed average-distribution arguments only together with arithmetic decompositions, coefficient bounds, and remainder control.
claim_ceiling: No automatic implication from an isolated inequality.

name: square-root distribution boundary
statement: Bombieri-Vinogradov supplies average distribution near exponent one-half, not distribution exponent one and not uniform control for every modulus.

name: average aggregation loss
statement: A small total discrepancy can coexist with exceptional moduli; aggregation loses the location and structure of outliers.
claim_ceiling: Average smallness cannot exclude every exceptional modulus.

name: average implies pointwise rejection
statement: Reject inference: average discrepancy bound implies the same bound for each individual modulus.
claim_ceiling: Counterexample required and included in verifier.

name: Bombieri-Vinogradov implies prime-producing theorem rejection
statement: Reject inference: average distribution alone proves a target prime-producing asymptotic.
claim_ceiling: Target purity, weights, and transfer certificates remain necessary.

name: average distribution claim ceiling
statement: Classify finite experiments as diagnostics, Bombieri-Vinogradov as known literature, and stronger distribution hypotheses as conditional or open.
claim_ceiling: No new theorem, no EH progress, no parity-barrier progress.
